definitions.attempts: Request files, including pending or unreadable requests.
definitions.completed_hops: Nonempty visible output, normal finish, known usage cost, no recorded exception; format may be invalid.
definitions.valid_passages: Completed hops whose parsed JSON has the original rule and nonempty string text.
definitions.verified: No per-request or receipt integrity error and request is readable.
definitions.pending: Request without a readable response receipt: outcome and billing unresolved; not classified as an API failure.
definitions.latency: All readable response receipts, including failures; excludes pending requests.
definitions.cost: Runner's conservative usage estimate, independently recomputed; not a provider invoice.

lexical.description: Descriptive lexical similarity; not semantic basin identification or an inferential test.
lexical.tail_selection: Last 20 completed hops per stream, then exclude invalid/unverified passages; never backfill.
lexical.representation: Only parsed text fields; the rule and other JSON fields are excluded.
lexical.tokenization: ASCII [a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?, lowercased, minimum length 2; no stemming.
lexical.weighting: Raw term count times log((1+N)/(1+df))+1; L2-normalized per passage.
lexical.centroid: L2-normalized sum of nonzero passage vectors per stream; cosine matrix in CSV.
lexical.empty_centroid_policy: CSV cell blank if either stream has no nonzero passage vectors.
